ledger: man in green/white striped shirt | facing camera, slicked dark hair, white undershirt, talking in front of wood-panelled door | back to camera, hands raised at a door panel left of coat hook | turns at ~07.0, camera follows him screen-left to door
navy jacket on brass hook | hanging on hook below brass medallion | same hook, white stripe on sleeve visible from other side | consistent across camera move
framed pictures | V/rearing-animal print at right edge, partially hidden print behind head | smiley-face line drawing revealed behind where head was | revealed by camera move

findings.description: From ~08.75 to 09.75 the man raises both hands to the middle of the door panel and makes fumbling/rubbing motions in empty air against flat wood, well above the doorknob (visible at bottom-left of frame); no handle, lock or knocking contact is evident, so the action reads as purposeless and unmotivated.

As the man turns away, his hair appears to gain a noticeably taller, more sculpted pompadour wave compared with the flatter slicked style seen from 00:00 to 06.75, with no action that would restyle it.
